verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe ByteAsk as a terminal coding agent that reads your codebase, edits files in the repository, compiles, runs tests and sanitizers, and presents a diff for review. That covers the core implement-or-fix loop, though its stated focus is C and C++. missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-file edits from a single natural-language request, concrete feature-implementation examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
